name: Select Customer for Estimate On Popover Open
purpose: Popover open handler for the estimate customer picker: clears the filter field, puts the cursor in it and refreshes the customer portal.

name: Select Customer for Estimate On Popover Close
purpose: Popover close handler for the estimate customer picker: clears the filter field and refreshes the customer portal.

name: Select Customer for Estimate: Filter
purpose: Filter-as-you-type handler for the estimate customer picker: remembers the text cursor, refreshes the customer portal and restores the cursor.

name: Select Customer for Estimate
purpose: Popover button: assigns the customer picked in the portal to the estimate and closes the popover.

name: Add Customer From Estimate
purpose: Add-customer button on the estimate: with an empty filter it moves the cursor to the new-customer name field; otherwise it clears the estimate's customer, commits, writes the filter text into the related customer's display name (creating a new customer through the relationship) and closes the popover.
writes:
Estimate::id_Customer#7 (step 4, current record)
Estimate_Customer::displayName#9 (step 7, current record)
open_question: Whether the relationship creates the customer (cascadeCreate) must be checked in the relationship explorer.

name: EstimateItem Amount OnObjectExit Trigger
purpose: Amount exit trigger on the estimate line: rounds the amount to 2 decimals and, when a unit price exists, recomputes the unit price (7 decimals) from amount / quantity only if unit price * quantity rounded differs from the amount. Mirrors the QBO interface.
writes:
EstimateItem::amount#6 (step 4, current record)
EstimateItem::unitPrice#7 (step 13, current record)

name: New Estimate for ( id_Customer )
purpose: Starts a new estimate for a customer: goes to the desktop estimate layout, creates a record and sets its customer. The iPad and iPhone branches are disabled.
open_question: Copy-paste remnants of Invoice steps (disabled) refer to InvoiceItem and Invoice::id.

name: Estimate OnCommit Trigger
purpose: On-commit trigger of the estimate: flags the estimate as modified (qbo_send = True) and sets subtotal, taxable subtotal and total (subtotal + total tax + shipping) from its lines. The automatic tax calculation is disabled, so total tax is entered by hand.
writes:
Estimate::qbo_send#3 (step 3, current record)
Estimate::subtotal#33 (step 7, current record)
Estimate::taxableSubtotal#34 (step 8, current record)
Estimate::totalAmt#25 (step 15, current record)
open_question: Total tax is not calculated here (steps 9-14 disabled); the tax rule lives elsewhere or is manual.
